# CARCAVELOS DAILY | 6 AUG 2026

**Small but clean—classic summer conditions with light winds this morning.**

**MORNING (dawn–11:00):** Expect 0.9–1.0m waves with 0.6m swell at 7.2s. NNW wind stays light (10–14 km/h) through 11:00—this is your window. Head out early before the breeze picks up; glassy conditions around sunrise.

**AFTERNOON EVOLUTION:** Swell gradually fades (0.54m by 17:00) while wind climbs steadily to 21+ km/h by 4pm. Waves stay consistent at 0.98m but chop builds noticeably after 2pm.

**OUTLOOK:** Summer-flat day overall. Quality drops hard after midday—definitely a morning mission.

**TIPS:** Grab a shortboard or fish; this is wave-height territory where drive matters. Get in before 11:00. Avoid the afternoon wind chop unless you're desperate.
